### Load Reference Datasets
```{bash}
# for Debaryomyces hansenii
# SEARCH: https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/datasets/genome/GCF_000006445.2/
# Download the reference genome from refseq .fna file 
wget -nc \
-P data_debaryomyces/ \
https://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/genomes/all/GCF/000/006/445/GCF_000006445.2_ASM644v2/GCF_000006445.2_ASM644v2_genomic.fna.gz

# Download the genome annotation file from refseq .ggf file 
wget -nc \
-P data_debaryomyces/ \
https://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/genomes/all/GCF/000/006/445/GCF_000006445.2_ASM644v2/GCF_000006445.2_ASM644v2_genomic.gff.gz

# Download the reference proteome from refseq .faa file 
wget -nc \
-P data_debaryomyces/ \
https://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/genomes/all/GCF/000/006/445/GCF_000006445.2_ASM644v2/GCF_000006445.2_ASM644v2_protein.faa.gz

# for Meyerozyma guilliermondii 
# SEARCH: https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/datasets/genome/GCF_000149425.1/
# Download the reference genome from refseq .fna file 
wget -nc \
-P data_meyerozyma/ \
https://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/genomes/all/GCF/000/149/425/GCF_000149425.1_ASM14942v1/GCF_000149425.1_ASM14942v1_genomic.fna.gz

# Download the genome annotation file from refseq .ggf file 
wget -nc \
-P data_meyerozyma/ \
https://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/genomes/all/GCF/000/149/425/GCF_000149425.1_ASM14942v1/GCF_000149425.1_ASM14942v1_genomic.gff.gz

# Download the reference proteome from refseq .faa file 
wget -nc \
-P data_meyerozyma/ \
https://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/genomes/all/GCF/000/149/425/GCF_000149425.1_ASM14942v1/GCF_000149425.1_ASM14942v1_protein.faa.gz
```

### Create Sequali Environment, if not already created. 
#### Set eval to FALSE to ensure code does not run during knit
```{bash, eval=FALSE}
conda create -n sequali-env python=3.11 -c conda-forge
conda activate sequali-env
conda install -c conda-forge -c bioconda sequali
```


### Run inital QC in Sequali Environment on d. Hansenii and m. Guilliermondii
Using Preliminary data 
```{bash, eval=FALSE}
conda activate sequali-env
sequali --outdir outputs_debaryomyces/dh_sequali_reports data_debaryomyces/debaryomycesHansenii2025.fastq
sequali --outdir outputs_meyerozyma/mg_sequali_reports data_meyerozyma/meyerozymaGuilliermondii2025.fastq
sequali --outdir outputs_debaryomyces/dh_sequali_reports data_debaryomyces/debaryomycesHansenii2026.fastq
sequali --outdir outputs_meyerozyma/mg_sequali_reports data_meyerozyma/meyerozymaGuilliermondii2026.fastq
conda deactivate 
```

### Based on the above metric fliter the reads using filtlong
Use conda to install [filtlong](https://anaconda.org/channels/bioconda/packages/filtlong/overview) package. Allows filtering of long reads based on certain criteria. Ie. average Q score or size. 
```{bash, eval=FALSE}
conda install bioconda::filtlong
```

Run downloaded file to analyse using filtlong package based on the QC sequali html file: 
```{bash, eval=FALSE}
filtlong --keep_percent 90 --min_length 1000 data_debaryomyces/debaryomycesHansenii2025.fastq | gzip > outputs_debaryomyces/filtered_debaryomycesHansenii2025.fastq.gz

filtlong --keep_percent 90 --min_length 1000 data_debaryomyces/debaryomycesHansenii2026.fastq | gzip > outputs_debaryomyces/filtered_debaryomycesHansenii2026.fastq.gz

filtlong --keep_percent 90 --min_length 1000 data_meyerozyma/meyerozymaGuilliermondii2025.fastq | gzip > outputs_meyerozyma/filtered_meyerozymaGuilliermondii2025.fastq.gz

filtlong --keep_percent 90 --min_length 1000 data_meyerozyma/meyerozymaGuilliermondii2026.fastq | gzip > outputs_meyerozyma/filtered_meyerozymaGuilliermondii2026.fastq.gz
```

### Run QC again in Sequali Environment to check filtered files
```{bash}
conda activate sequali-env
sequali --outdir outputs_debaryomyces/filtered_sequali_reports outputs_debaryomyces/filtered_debaryomycesHansenii2025.fastq.gz
```

## Assmebly 
### use Flye novo assembler
Create Flye environment if not already done
```{bash, eval=FALSE}
conda create -n flye-env python=3.10 -c conda-forge
conda activate flye-env
conda install flye=2.9.6 -c bioconda
```

### Flye - Run 5 rounds of internal polishing
[Flye](https://github.com/mikolmogorov/Flye/blob/flye/docs/USAGE.md)
Why are you having us do 5 iterations/ runs? Reduce mapping errors by alignment to corrected assembly with subseqent iteration. how can you tell if you over polished? What biological background/ understanding is required? 
```{bash, eval=FALSE}
# Ensure the output directory exists
mkdir -p outputs_debaryomyces/flye_output2025
mkdir -p outputs_meyerozyma/flye_output2025

mkdir -p outputs_debaryomyces/flye_output2026
mkdir -p outputs_meyerozyma/flye_output2026

conda activate flye-env
# Run the Flye assembler, note the expected genome size
flye --nano-raw outputs_debaryomyces/filtered_debaryomycesHansenii2025.fastq.gz --out-dir outputs_debaryomyces/flye_output2025 --threads 8 --genome-size 12m --iterations 5

flye --nano-raw outputs_meyerozyma/filtered_meyerozymaGuilliermondii2025.fastq.gz --out-dir outputs_meyerozyma/flye_output2025 --threads 8 --genome-size 12m --iterations 5

flye --nano-raw outputs_debaryomyces/filtered_debaryomycesHansenii2026.fastq.gz --out-dir outputs_debaryomyces/flye_output2026 --threads 8 --genome-size 12m --iterations 5

flye --nano-raw outputs_meyerozyma/filtered_meyerozymaGuilliermondii2026.fastq.gz --out-dir outputs_meyerozyma/flye_output2026 --threads 8 --genome-size 12m --iterations 5
conda deactivate 
```

## Polish draft assembly

```{bash, eval=FALSE}
conda activate medaka_final
```

Run 2 rounds of medaka - Debaryomyces individually 2025 and 2026 samples
```{bash}

mkdir -p outputs_debaryomyces/medaka_round1_2026 outputs_debaryomyces/medaka_round2_2026

# Activate your environment
conda activate medaka_final

# Round 1 2025
medaka_consensus -i outputs_debaryomyces/filtered_debaryomycesHansenii2025.fastq.gz -d outputs_debaryomyces/flye_output2025/assembly.fasta -o outputs_debaryomyces/medaka_round1_2025 -t 8
```


## Evaluate the assembly
### Structural annotation - funannotate 
funannotate - Debaryomyces
```{bash, eval=FALSE}
mkdir -p outputs_debaryomyces/funannotate_prep

# Define reusable variables
IMAGE="nextgenusfs/funannotate:v1.8.15"
PLATFORM="--platform linux/amd64"
CPUS=8
INPUT="outputs_debaryomyces/medaka_round2/consensus.fasta"
SPECIES="Debaryomyces hansenii"  
STRAIN="KL2"      

# Step 1: Clean redundant/short contigs ("genomic dust")
docker run -u $(id -u):$(id -g) --rm -v "$PWD":/outputs_debaryomyces -w /outputs_debaryomyces $PLATFORM $IMAGE \
  funannotate clean \
  -i $INPUT \
  -o outputs_debaryomyces/funannotate_prep/assembly_clean.fasta

# Step 2: Sort contigs by length and standardize header names (scaffold_1, etc.)
docker run -u $(id -u):$(id -g) --rm -v "$PWD":/outputs_debaryomyces -w /outputs_debaryomyces $PLATFORM $IMAGE \
  funannotate sort \
  -i outputs_debaryomyces/funannotate_prep/assembly_clean.fasta \
  -o outputs_debaryomyces/funannotate_prep/assembly_sorted.fasta

# Step 3: Soft-mask repetitive elements
docker run -u $(id -u):$(id -g) --rm -v "$PWD":/outputs_debaryomyces -w /outputs_debaryomyces $PLATFORM $IMAGE \
  funannotate mask \
  -i outputs_debaryomyces/funannotate_prep/assembly_sorted.fasta \
  -o outputs_debaryomyces/funannotate_prep/assembly_masked.fasta \
  --cpus $CPUS

# Step 4: Predict gene models using Saccharomycetes BUSCO models for training
docker run -u $(id -u):$(id -g) --rm -v "$PWD":/outputs_debaryomyces -w /outputs_debaryomyces $PLATFORM $IMAGE \
  funannotate predict \
  -i outputs_debaryomyces/funannotate_prep/assembly_masked.fasta \
  -o outputs_debaryomyces/funannotate_out \
  -s "$SPECIES" \
  --strain "$STRAIN" \
  --busco_db saccharomycetes_odb12 \
  --augustus_species debaryomyces_hansenii \
  --protein_evidence data_debaryomyces/GCF_000006445.2_ASM644v2_protein.faa \
  --cpus $CPUS
```

funannotate - Meyerozyma

### eggNOG

```{bash}
# Create a dedicated Conda environment to install eggNOG-mapper and its fast sequence aligner (diamond):
conda create -n eggnog_env -c conda-forge -c bioconda python=3.10 eggnog-mapper

# run eggNOG-mapper
eval "$(conda shell.bash hook)"  # initialize conda 
conda activate eggnog_env

# USB to get eggnog_data on compute
EGGNOG_DB_PATH=/Users/hmangat02/Desktop/GenomicAnalysis/eggnog_db 

# Debaryomyces
emapper.py \
  -i outputs_debaryomyces/funannotate_out/predict_results/*.proteins.fa \
  --output isolate_functional \
  --output_dir outputs_debaryomyces/funannotate_out \
  --data_dir $EGGNOG_DB_PATH \
  --decorate_gff yes \
  --excel \
  -m diamond \
  --cpu 8
  
# Meyerozyma
emapper.py \
  -i outputs_meyerozyma/funannotate_out/predict_results/*.proteins.fa \
  --output isolate_functional \
  --output_dir outputs_meyerozyma/funannotate_out \
  --data_dir $EGGNOG_DB_PATH \
  --decorate_gff yes \
  --excel \
  -m diamond \
  --cpu 8
```
